start: Staff & sign-in, signed in as an owner, list "People who can sign in" with one front desk person

steps.action: On the other person's row tap the red "Remove"
user_sees: "<name> is signed out of every phone and computer. They can’t sign in again. Your members and payments stay as they are."
must_not: The person is removed before the owner confirms
A Remove button on the owner's own row

user_sees: Button reads "Working…" and cannot be tapped again
The person is gone from the list
must_not: The person still in the list after the toast
Any member, payment or receipt the person saved is changed or deleted
Two remove calls from a double tap

steps.action: On the removed person's phone, open the panel
user_sees: Sign-in page with "You no longer have access to this gym. Talk to the gym owner."
must_not: The removed person can still open or save anything
The removed person can sign in again with the old PIN or an old code

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; the same person was already removed from another device a moment ago

steps.action: Tap "Remove" on the stale row, then "Remove" in the sheet
user_sees: Red line in the sheet: "That person was already removed. We updated the list."
must_not: A success toast for a removal that did nothing
The sheet stuck on "Working…"
The gone person still shown after the list is loaded again

start: Staff & sign-in, signed in as front desk staff (not an owner)

user_sees: Only the "You" card and "Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner."
No list of people, no Remove button
must_not: A staff person sees other people's mobile numbers
A staff person can remove anyone

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner of a gym with two owners

steps.action: Try a removal that would leave the gym with no owner (the server answers that a gym needs an owner)
user_sees: Red line: "A gym needs at least one owner. Add another owner first."
must_not: A gym left with no owner
The owner removing himself: his own row has no Remove button

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; a person was removed earlier

steps.action: Tap "Add a person" and add the same name and mobile number again
user_sees: Toast "<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them."
The person is back in the list with no devices
must_not: "This mobile number is already on the list." for a person who was removed
The old sessions or the old PIN working again by themselves

steps.action: Tap "Make sign-in code" on the new row
user_sees: A 6-digit code with "Works once, till <time> (30 minutes)."
must_not: The re-added person signed in anywhere before using a new code

start: Remove sheet open for a person

user_sees: The list unchanged, the person still there
must_not: The person removed or signed out by opening and closing the sheet

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner, just after removing a person who saved payments

steps.action: Open Members and a receipt that the removed person collected
user_sees: The receipt and the member as before
must_not: The removed person's work deleted
The removed person still able to read member names or numbers on any device
The removed person's mobile number still shown in the people list
